name: BioProCorpus
description: We constructed BioProCorpus, a biomedical named entity recognition corpus derived from publicly available proteomics project descriptions. The corpus contains 1,228 annotated documents, 7,947 BIO-formatted sequences, 205,149 tokens, and 26,832 entity mentions across eight categories: Cellline, Chemical, Disease, Gene, Process, Protein, Species, and Technique. The release includes source and preprocessed records, two independent manual annotation layers, the expert-adjudicated complete gold-standard corpus, and fixed training, validation, and test benchmark partitions. BioProCorpus.zip also provides the annotation guidelines, quality-control records, baseline-model code, and the HybridNER training, evaluation, and ablation resources needed to support transparent reuse and reproducible biomedical information-extraction research.
